classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Design 1-2 binder candidates against the provided target structure using BindCraft (two independent seed shards), evaluate interface confidence with ipSAE on each predicted complex, and rank the candidates to identify the top design for downstream review.
assumptions: Target PDB is accessible at the path supplied in params.target_pdb at workflow runtime.
Target occupies chain A; BindCraft places the designed binder on chain B in the predicted complex output.
BindCraft end-to-end output exposes a per-design predicted PDB and PAE matrix file via outputs.design_1.pdb_path / outputs.design_1.pae_path and equivalently for design_2.

Two independent trajectory shards (seed 1 and seed 2, num_designs=1 each) satisfy the 1-2 candidate budget and respect the tool recommended_shard_size of 1; max_parallel=2 matches default_max_parallel.
Binder length is kept at the tool default of 60 residues for minimal runtime choices; no scientific reason to deviate without target-specific context.
No hotspot residues are specified; BindCraft will autonomously locate the binding interface — a valid design strategy when hotspots are unknown.
num_recycles=1 is the tool default and sufficient for a compact run; higher values improve accuracy at proportionally greater compute cost.
ipSAE cutoff and dist_cutoff are left at their defaults (10.0 Å) as the standard interface-scoring threshold.
rank_designs aggregates both ipsae analyses alongside both design job records and returns a top-2 ranked table; the highest-ranked entry is the natural candidate for a subsequent submission decision.
missing_inputs: target_pdb: path to the target structure (.pdb) must be provided at runtime — no concrete default is known

success_criteria.ranked_table_produced: rank_designs output with top_k=2 ordered by aggregated ipSAE interface confidence
success_criteria.top_candidate_identified: highest-ranked design record available for a post-round submission decision
